assets.ti: Report of Air Force Research Regarding the "Roswell Incident" (July 1994)
assets.de: The Air Force's July 1994 report on the "Roswell Incident", prepared during a GAO audit requested by Rep. Steven Schiff. It concludes the material recovered near Roswell in 1947 was consistent with a balloon device and most likely came from a Project Mogul balloon train, and found no records of a crashed spacecraft or recovered bodies. Released in DoD's 2021 UAP FOIA reading-room batch.

assets.ti: GAO B-262046: Results of a Search for Records Concerning the 1947 Crash Near Roswell, New Mexico (28 Jul 1995)
assets.de: The General Accounting Office's 28 July 1995 letter to Rep. Steven H. Schiff on its search for government records about the reported 1947 crash near Roswell. GAO found four Army Air Forces accidents in New Mexico that July, all involving military aircraft and all after 8 July, and that RAAF administrative records for March 1945 to December 1949 had been destroyed. Released in DoD's 2021 UAP FOIA reading-room batch.

assets.ti: DIA routing slip with the attaché cable on the 1976 Tehran UFO incident (8 Dec 1978)
assets.de: A Defense Intelligence Agency routing and transmittal slip dated 8 December 1978, filed with the U.S. attaché cable reporting the September 1976 night intercepts of a bright object over Tehran by Imperial Iranian Air Force F-4s, including a radar lock-on. Released in DoD's 2021 UAP FOIA reading-room batch.

assets.ti: "Now You See It, Now You Don't!": the 1976 Tehran F-4 intercepts
assets.de: An Air Force article by Capt. Henry S. Shields, HQ USAFE, recounting the September 1976 episode in which two Imperial Iranian Air Force F-4 Phantom crews chased a brightly lit object near Tehran. Released in DoD's 2021 UAP FOIA reading-room batch.
